placements.why: The decision to run monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals is an architectural and operational design choice that establishes system dependability under failure conditions. No existing strata category covers this; the repo starts empty and this content calls for an Architecture category.
placements.title: Structural and Operational Design
placements.theme: The system's architectural and operational choices determine what is actually dependable when stressed.

placements.title: From Assumed to Proven Rollback Capability
placements.theme: A rollback you have not rehearsed is a rollback you do not actually have — regular rehearsal cadence converts theoretical recovery into proven capability.
placements.why: src-1 is Quinton Fairweather's commissive decision that Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly, grounded in the principle that an unrehearsed rollback is not one you actually have. src-2 restates that decision as a summary. Both segments express the same thematic direction: rehearsal cadence is the mechanism that establishes whether a rollback is real. No existing leaf holds this theme.
